TASK_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 这个项目没有这项操作
TASK_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE.en: This project does not offer that action

TASK_ARTIFACT_CHANGED.zh: 文件在任务结束后被改动，可能已被新的构建覆盖
TASK_ARTIFACT_CHANGED.en: The file changed after the task finished, possibly replaced by a newer build

TASK_ARTIFACT_MISSING.en: The file is no longer there

TASK_BUSY.zh: 这个项目已有任务在运行
TASK_BUSY.en: Another task is already running in this project

TASK_CONFIRM_REQUIRED.zh: 这条命令来自已安装的插件，首次运行前需要确认
TASK_CONFIRM_REQUIRED.en: This command comes from an installed plugin and needs your confirmation before it first runs

TASK_PLAN_INVALID.zh: 插件给出的执行计划无效：{message}
TASK_PLAN_INVALID.en: The plugin returned an invalid plan: {message}

TASK_PROVIDER_STOPPING.zh: 插件正在等待运行中的任务结束后关闭，暂不接受新任务
TASK_PROVIDER_STOPPING.en: The plugin is turning off once its running tasks end and accepts no new tasks

TASK_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 提供这项任务的插件已关闭
TASK_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.en: The plugin that provides this task is off

TASK_REQUEST_CONFLICT.zh: 这个请求编号已用于另一项任务
TASK_REQUEST_CONFLICT.en: This request id was already used for a different task

TASKS_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 此系统不支持项目任务
TASKS_UNSUPPORTED.en: Project tasks are not supported on this system
